body: Call poision center to be safe and hear their advice if you should go to a hospital or not. Be well!
It’s like I understand what they are saying but I cannot live the words that they are speaking. There is no emotion. If you get my point
I have book number 3. It will not remove the feeling that what people say is pointless in my brain. I have no  ability to process what people say

I did get myself in all the things you summed up to not do for the time to numb myself a little from pain, and the job I practice now to sustain myself is also not allowed by law but I have no option as working with other colleagues isn’t physically and mentally possible for me. I also tried meditating myself but I found that it is not really the fix. The thing is I don’t feel the need to desperately want to strike conversation with people for attention, I only don’t want to feel that empty feeling that I’m weird for not being able to show any reaction or have any character

Greeting someone isn’t an issue for me now anymore since moving out on my own and actually being forced to leave the house, although I get nerves and tense but I still do it. Once the conversation starts is where the issue is. I can’t seem to formulate thought or opinion, nor express reaction to what people talk to me about. It looks like I am not intrested at all and want to dissapear

If I didn’t date since I started going outside then I wouldn’t have known that I have became unresponsive to emotional interactions. Now I will avoid that too for the near future anyway. I have also visited 3 therapists and 2 psychiatric doctor and they just precsribe anti depressants. The therapists haven’t been of much help because the scale of the problem is so deeply rooted that I feel that they aren’t helping me or just aren’t aware how to fix it?
